column3: “Answered and said” is rendered “continued and said.”
“More than God” is rendered “more than God's.”
“To you” is rendered “to You”; NASB supplies “more than if I had sinned.”
“Indeed? if” is rendered “How much less when.” The written text reads “you will wait,” and the meaning is uncertain.
“Folly” is rendered “transgression,” and “exceedingly” as “well”; the meaning of the Hebrew word is uncertain.
